body.name: Cycle-cancellation support handle
body.construction: For the uniform upper direction, apply cycle cancellation separately to the lower- and upper-endpoint transportation tables, then compress within each categorical block of the finite-cell \(\operatorname{TAKE}\) refinement while retaining the active affine or minimum-cut certificate. For the matching lower direction, use endpoint-face rank and forced-positive-cell obstructions to construct compatible margin families for which \(\max\{s_L(o,e),s_U(o,e)\}\) is large.
